locale.description: Locale for tool titles. Defaults to English.

portalUrl.description: Base URL of the Data Fair portal. Required in standalone mode (stdio transport).

dataFairAPIKey.description: API key sent to Data Fair for authentication. Used in standalone mode.

trustedForwarder.description: Secret sent to the ingress (X-Trusted-Forwarder) with the caller's IP in X-Forwarded-For, or with none for a caller acting for no address. Used in stack mode.

mainSiteUrl.description: Origin of the main site (https://host). The platform document is fetched from it; upstream calls swap it for the requesting site's origin. In stdio mode defaults to portalUrl.

docPath.description: Path of the merged platform OpenAPI document on the main site.

privateDirectoryUrl.description: In-cluster URL of the directory service (signing keys, session).

mcpServer.description: Which tool set a standalone (stdio) server serves: the seven dataset tools or the whole platform.

refreshInterval.description: Seconds between conditional re-fetches of the platform document and its linked skill bodies; 0 disables.

upstreamProxyHost.description: Optional in-cluster reverse proxy (host or host:port) every site host resolves to; the request keeps the site's Host and gains X-Forwarded-Host/Proto.

limits.description: Calls to IGN: a global budget per instance (IGN allows 50 requests per second per source IP, divide by replicas) and a per-caller one, so no caller fills the global one.

files.description: File inputs (indirect uploads, see @data-fair/openapi-mcp docs/x-agent.md#files). Without a URL prefix, tools that need a file are not offered.

urlPrefixes.description: URL prefixes of the agents' file store (endpoint and bucket path); the only URLs a file input is fetched from.

maxSize.description: Largest file accepted, in bytes; default 104857600 (100 MiB).

timeout.description: Seconds from the request to the last byte of a file; default 300.
